Holder Wilsey Asset Management Has Raised Apple (AAPL) Holding; Advisory Research Has Decreased Holding in Enterprise Products Partners L (EPD) by $1.20 Million as Market Value Declined
May 16, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Advisory Research Inc decreased its stake in Enterprise Products Partners L (EPD) by 2.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Advisory Research Inc sold 46,146 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.22% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.91M shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.58M, down from 1.95M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Advisory Research Inc who had been investing in Enterprise Products Partners L for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $61.27 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.11% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $28.2. About 3.78 million shares traded. Enterprise Products Partners L.P. (NYSE:EPD) has declined 10.03% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.58% the S&P500.
Wilsey Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wilsey Asset Management Inc bought 2,257 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 85,594 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.49M, up from 83,337 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wilsey Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $924.69B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Advisory Research Inc, which manages about $11.47 billion and $6.04 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Irhythm Technologies Incorpora by 12,980 shares to 97,548 shares, valued at $5.47 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
